method.reason: Use the widely available B3LYP hybrid functional for geometry optimization and frequency analysis of neutral singlet ethanol; the official ORCA manual section on density functional theory documents its exchange-correlation definition and parametrization, while final scientific validity remains checked by ORCA execution.

sources.quote: The popular B3LYP functional (20% HF exchange) as defined in the TurboMole program system (LDAOPT C_VWN5)

basis.reason: Choose the polarized valence triple-zeta def2-TZVP orbital basis, documented for first-row organic elements and suitable for ethanol geometry optimization and vibrational frequencies within the available resources.
